legend: Vasily has a deck of cards consisting of n cards. There is an integer on each of the cards, this integer is between 1 and 100 000, inclusive. It is possible that some cards have the same integers on them.

Vasily decided to sort the cards. To do this, he repeatedly takes the top card from the deck, and if the number on it equals the minimum number written on the cards in the deck, then he places the card away. Otherwise, he puts it under the deck and takes the next card from the top, and so on. The process ends as soon as there are no cards in the deck. You can assume that Vasily always knows the minimum number written on some card in the remaining deck, but doesn't know where this card (or these cards) is.
You are to determine the total number of times Vasily takes the top card from the deck.
input: The first line contains single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100 000) — the number of cards in the deck.
The second line contains a sequence of n integers a1, a2, ..., an (1 ≤ ai ≤ 100 000), where ai is the number written on the i-th from top card in the deck.
output: Print the total number of times Vasily takes the top card from the deck.
note: In the first example Vasily at first looks at the card with number 6 on it, puts it under the deck, then on the card with number 3, puts it under the deck, and then on the card with number 1. He places away the card with 1, because the number written on it is the minimum among the remaining cards. After that the cards from top to bottom are [2, 6, 3]. Then Vasily looks at the top card with number 2 and puts it away. After that the cards from top to bottom are [6, 3]. Then Vasily looks at card 6, puts it under the deck, then at card 3 and puts it away. Then there is only one card with number 6 on it, and Vasily looks at it and puts it away. Thus, in total Vasily looks at 7 cards.

legend.ai: Vasily 有一副由 n 张卡片组成的牌堆。每张卡片上都有一个整数，该整数在 1 到 100 000（含）之间。可能存在一些卡片上的整数相同。
Vasily 决定将这些卡片排序。为此，他会反复从牌堆顶端取出一张卡片；如果卡片上的数字等于牌堆中卡片上写着的最小数字，那么他就将这张卡片放到一边。否则，他会将这张卡片放到牌堆底部，然后从顶端取出下一张卡片，如此继续。当牌堆中没有卡片时，过程结束。可以认为 Vasily 始终知道剩余牌堆中某张卡片上写着的最小数字，但不知道这张卡片（或这些卡片）在哪里。
请你确定 Vasily 从牌堆顶端取出卡片的总次数。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 100 000），表示牌堆中卡片的数量。
第二行包含 n 个整数 a1， a2， ...， an（1 ≤ ai ≤ 100 000），其中 ai 表示牌堆中从顶端数第 i 张卡片上的数字。

output.ai: 输出 Vasily 从牌堆中拿出顶牌的总次数。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，Vasily 首先查看写有数字 6 的牌，将它放到牌堆底部；然后查看写有数字 3 的牌，将它放到牌堆底部；接着查看写有数字 1 的牌。由于牌上写的数字在剩余牌中最小，他将这张牌取出。此时，从上到下的牌依次为 [2, 6, 3]。随后 Vasily 查看顶端写有数字 2 的牌，并将其取出。此时，从上到下的牌依次为 [6, 3]。然后 Vasily 查看牌 6，将它放到牌堆底部；接着查看牌 3，并将其取出。此时只剩下一张写有数字 6 的牌，Vasily 查看它并将其取出。因此，Vasily 总共查看了 7 张牌。
